assumptions.statement: Repository provisional polygons are used because official SITE_BOUNDARY is unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All area and topology results must be recalculated when official geometry is supplied.

assumptions.statement: The three key-area polygons are provisional constraints.
assumptions.impact: Detailed-design limits are discussion envelopes, not official redlines.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines and facility standards are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No statutory control values are asserted.

assumptions.statement: No complete heritage survey or protection-control geometry is available.
assumptions.impact: Heritage actions are reversible concepts pending specialist survey.

assumptions.statement: Conceptual footprints represent program capacity envelopes, not surveyed buildings.
assumptions.impact: They cannot support demolition, retention or compensation decisions.

assumptions.statement: Road and slow-mobility lines are network concepts without traffic-model calibration.
assumptions.impact: Crossings and station interfaces require transport-engineering review.

assumptions.statement: Known spatial metrics are computed from submitted provisional/design geometry.
assumptions.impact: Values are reproducible but not official planning indicators.

assumptions.statement: Public standards guide evidence structure at concept stage.
assumptions.impact: Final planning and engineering compliance requires current full-text professional review.

assumptions.statement: Six global cases are mechanism references only.
assumptions.impact: No case size, performance or transferability claim is used as local proof.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios are opt-in service and test concepts.
assumptions.impact: Personal tracking, automated enforcement and unreviewed high-impact decisions are excluded.

assumptions.statement: Operators, budgets and procurement paths are not assigned.
assumptions.impact: Phasing and governance are recommendations, not government commitments.

assumptions.statement: All diagrams are programmatically generated from repository and submission data.
assumptions.impact: No third-party case imagery or unlicensed brand asset is embedded.
